---
title: "Self-Referenced Trajectory Modelling (SRTM) Results"
format:
  pdf:
    toc: true
    number-sections: true
    keep-tex: true
  docx:
    toc: true
    number-sections: true
params:
  results_rds: null
  fig_width: !expr 7
  fig_height: !expr 4.5
  dpi: 300
  plot_palette: "simple"
  alpha: 0.05
  pdf_paginate: false
  debug: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

# pull parameters from Quarto
results_rds   <- params$results_rds
fig_width     <- params$fig_width
fig_height    <- params$fig_height
dpi           <- params$dpi
plot_palette  <- params$plot_palette
alpha         <- params$alpha
pdf_paginate  <- params$pdf_paginate
debug         <- params$debug

if (is.null(results_rds) || !file.exists(results_rds)) {
  stop("Parameter 'results_rds' is NULL or file does not exist. ",
       "Please call generateSRTMResultsReport() so that 'results_rds' is supplied.")
}

# global chunk options: figure size + dpi
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width  = fig_width,
  fig.height = fig_height,
  dpi        = dpi
)

# load SRTM analysis and build report object
results <- readRDS(results_rds)

report_obj <- SRTM::report(
  results       = results,
  alpha         = alpha,
  plot_palette  = plot_palette,
  debug         = debug
)

txt   <- report_obj$text
tbl   <- report_obj$table
figs  <- report_obj$figures  %||% list()
order <- report_obj$figure_order %||% names(figs)

pg_list <- figs$per_group %||% list()
```

## Group-by-group Details

```{r}
#| echo: false
if (length(pg_list) == 0L) {
  cat("No group-specific figures were generated.\n")
} else {
  for (pg_name in names(pg_list)) {
    pg <- pg_list[[pg_name]]

    cat("\n\n---\n\n")
    cat("### ", pg$heading, "\n\n")

    if (!is.null(pg$text) && length(pg$text) > 0L) {
      cat(paste(pg$text, collapse = "\n\n"), "\n\n")
    }

    if (!is.null(pg$figure)) {
      print(pg$figure)
    }

    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```
